description: Which Arc agents are worth buying from: ranked by distinct OUTSIDE payers read from Arc settlements, with payments, USDC, payer concentration and whether the agent answers now. Track record, not price; concentrated and shared-payout cases are flagged. $0.005 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

name: arc_seller_rank
